title: Gradebook loses a last-slot write
summary: The regression returns the previous mark but omits the final-slot write. The repair skips only redundant writes.

change.description: The regression returns the previous mark but omits the final-slot write. The repair skips only redundant writes.

notes: The JVM checks all 306 inputs against a previous-value and per-cell oracle. Only the regression disagrees, on 78 full poststates. All versions agree on the 189 interior poststates and every untargeted cell.
verdictLabel: Regression disagrees with 78 of 306 full poststates on the JVM
